title: Somewhere Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Somewhere is a 1 BR / 1.5 BA / 4 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Delightfully artistic and perfectly situated near the Ruskin Place Artist Colony, Somewhere is a stunning guest cottage that offers vacationers the ideal access to the entire Seaside experience.
description_expanded: Description152 EAST RUSKIN STREET2 QUEENSA Charming Guest Cottage in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaDelightfully artistic and ideally located near the Ruskin Place Artist Colony, Somewhere is a charming Seaside guest cottage that places you steps from the very best of this iconic beach town. From galleries and boutiques to dining, the beach, and the town center, this thoughtfully designed retreat offers effortless access to the full Seaside experience—all while providing a peaceful, tucked-away escape.Inviting Outdoor Living & Tranquil Porch SpacesA private, canopied entrance leads you directly to the screened-in front porch, where coastal breezes and serene surroundings set the tone for your stay. This inviting outdoor space is perfect for savoring morning coffee, unwinding with an evening cocktail, or simply soaking in the relaxed rhythm of Seaside. The cottage’s calming décor and artistic touches create an immediate sense of ease from the moment you arrive.Comfortable Living Spaces with Thoughtful DesignInside, Somewhere features a cozy living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a built-in dining area—ideal for casual meals after a day at the beach or an evening spent exploring town. Every inch of the cottage is designed to feel warm, functional, and welcoming, offering all the comforts of home in an intimate setting.A convenient half bath on the first floor opens directly to a private outdoor shower, allowing you to rinse off beneath the Florida sky after a beach day—or enjoy a refreshing open-air shower under the stars.Private Upstairs Sleeping RetreatUpstairs, the second level offers a comfortable bedroom with two queen beds and a full bathroom, providing a restful retreat for couples, friends, or a small family. The layout balances privacy with connection, making it easy to relax and recharge between Seaside adventures.A Quaint Seaside Escape Near It AllPerfectly positioned and thoughtfully designed, Somewhere is an ideal Seaside vacation rental for guests seeking charm, comfort, and walkable access to everything Seaside, Florida has to offer. Whether you’re here for the art scene, the beach, or the laid-back coastal lifestyle, this delightful guest cottage invites you to slow down, settle in, and truly enjoy your stay.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES770 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion3-minute walk (176 yards) to private beach accessPeacock Alley premium linens featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityWasher and dryer for guest conveniencePersonalized service throughout your stay with thoughtful attention to detailStarter amenities provided upon arrivalParking: One parking pass for one-bedroom cottages; two parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homesA golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002435
